skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Attacks a single target with 2 hit combo for 120% ATK DMG. 100% chance to inflict [Crash Bad] for 2 turns (injury-free rate reduced by 20%).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in the entire row with 3 hit combo for 420% ATK DMG. Each hit has a 100% chance to apply 1 stack of [Specialized Burn] (deals DoT equal to 150% ATK, disappearing after 3 times. After any enemy takes action, it spreads to others that do not have this effect).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: ATK 420% → 600%. [Specialized Burn] DoT 150% → 200%. Grants 20% Non-crit DMG reduction to all allies for 2 turns.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At the start of battle, grants 50% DoT increase to all allies, lasting up to 4 turns. After [Specialized Burn] and [Detonate] deal DMG to enemies, G4 and his same-row allies recover 40% of DMG dealt as [Specialized Guard].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At the start of the battle, all enemies will be inflicted with [Specialized Burn] (This effect is unaffected by Hit, deals continuous damage for 150% ATK that will disappear after 3 times. After any enemy takes action, it will spread to others that does not have this effect). Before any character action, clear [Stun] or [Specialized Stun] of 1 ally up to 2 times per round. After any character action, for every enemy that is in [Specialized Burn] state, increase 10% ATK of allies, can be stacked up to 3 times for 1 round.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: At the start of battle > For the first 3 rounds Dispel stun 2x per round > 3x Increase allies atk 10% > 15% Self gain permanent immunity to Stun/S.Stun

effects.desc: PvP tier of Stun — harder to resist or resolve.
The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
PvP-tier shields absorb incoming damage, granted at a value based on Attack (e.g. 400% ATK).
Activate a stack of damage over time or stored [Collapse] to instantly explode, turning it into an instant multiplier (e.g. 3 times the stored damage).
Burning PvP tier — stronger burst damage, harder to deal with.
